turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
w
Seen • Just now
No — once an order is placed with Standard Ground Shipping, it can’t be upgraded to a faster shipping option. 
The only faster option is Flaviar Express, which delivers in about 90 minutes or less, but it must be selected at checkout and is only available for certain eligible products. 
So for an existing order, the shipping speed can’t be changed after purchase.

So the focus is on delivery first, and then the situation can be assessed afterward.
